name: Proxima Fusion
description: Designs fusion power plants based on stellarators, a type of reactor that uses magnetic fields to confine plasma. The company spun out of the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics.

fit.rationale: The stellarator design draws on Max Planck Institute research. The Series A puts this snapshot beyond the seed-stage scouting window.

name: Avelios Medical
description: Builds modular hospital software for clinical workflows and patient documentation. Its tools help care teams capture structured treatment data during everyday work.

fit.rationale: Modular clinical workflows and structured patient data support fit. The announcement provides limited detail on a hard-to-copy technical advantage.

name: Symphera
description: Develops surgical instruments for minimally invasive procedures. Its system is designed to let surgeons switch tools during laparoscopic surgery without manually swapping instruments.

fit.rationale: The device combines multiple laparoscopic tools in a single instrument with an automated switching mechanism.

name: AUDAVIS
description: Develops AI-assisted financial auditing software. Its Artificial Auditor helps audit teams analyze transactions and check the quality of financial data.

fit.rationale: AI-assisted transaction checks are a clear digital tech use case. The announcement gives limited detail on how the AI is differentiated.

name: Auxilius
description: Builds software for enterprise governance, risk, and compliance. It turns policies into rules that run automatically and produce evidence for internal monitoring and audits.

fit.rationale: Executable controls are a concrete technical approach to automating enterprise compliance.

name: lytra
description: Builds AI software for the after-sales service teams of machinery manufacturers. It automates service requests and helps operators find product and process knowledge.

fit.rationale: Factory pilots support the industrial use case. The announcement describes early product evidence with limited detail on the underlying AI.

name: Zentio
description: Builds production planning software for manufacturers. It brings together machine and operations data so factories can adjust schedules as conditions change.

fit.rationale: The platform combines machine data, mathematical optimization and automation for real-time production planning.

name: IonKraft
description: Develops plasma coatings for plastic packaging. The coatings provide a barrier for protecting packaged goods while making the packaging easier to recycle.

fit.rationale: The RWTH spin-off builds plasma-coating machinery. The first equity round and planned launch support early-stage fit.

name: mo:re
description: Builds lab equipment and software to automate 3D cell culture experiments. Its platform helps research teams run and analyze studies on cell models for animal-free drug development.

fit.rationale: Dedicated lab hardware automates several steps in 3D cell culture, with software to standardize experiments.

name: Heidelberg Epignostix
description: Develops software to classify tumors from DNA methylation patterns. Its first product focuses on distinguishing brain tumor subtypes that are difficult to tell apart with standard methods.

fit.rationale: The tumor classifier builds on a decade of research into how DNA methylation patterns distinguish cancer subtypes.
